scenes.title: A Patch of Bare Earth
scenes.body: In a sunny meadow, a little fox and a small rabbit found a bare patch of ground. They decided to make it a garden together. They patted the soft soil and planted tiny seeds.
scenes.altText: Scene 1 of a story about friendship.

scenes.title: Water and Wait
scenes.body: Every day the friends watered the seeds. They sang a little song while the sun shone down. Soon a tiny green sprout appeared, and they cheered.
scenes.altText: Scene 2 of a story about friendship.

scenes.title: The Helpful Fence
scenes.body: One morning a strong wind blew through the meadow. The little sprouts swayed and shivered. The friends worked together to build a low fence of twigs and stones, and the garden felt cozy and safe.
scenes.altText: Scene 3 of a story about friendship.

scenes.title: Flowers Everywhere
scenes.body: The sprouts grew taller and taller. Pretty flowers opened in pink, yellow, and blue. The fox and the rabbit smiled as butterflies danced around the bright petals.
scenes.altText: Scene 4 of a story about friendship.

scenes.title: A Garden to Share
scenes.body: The fox and the rabbit sat under the flowers and shared a cozy picnic. They laughed and watched the bees buzz softly. And from that day on, they always tended their garden together, because the best gardens grow with a friend.
scenes.altText: Scene 5 of a story about friendship.
